summary: Found the group's implementation (advisory.py, cli.py wiring, pipeline.py graph-build seam, test_advisory.py) already substantially written from a prior session. Fixed two bugs: a missing cli.py import for build_advisory_report/serialize_advisory_report that would have caused a NameError on any real `group --advise` invocation, and a test fixture in test_map_error_surfaces_as_grouper_error that lacked the task-map version marker so it exercised the 'absent map -> LLM mapper fallback' path instead of the intended 'malformed map -> TaskMapError' path. Verified all four cohesion thresholds are named module constants with in-code justification, ran the full test_advisory.py suite (13/13 pass) plus the broader suite (only pre-existing, unrelated sandbox-environment failures in test_cli.py/test_finish.py remain, present before my changes), and did an end-to-end CLI smoke test in a scratch repo confirming `group --advise` builds the graph once, prints the granularity/cohesion report, writes valid preview/advisory.json, and never touches groups.json.

verification_results.notes: TestOneGraphBuild covers single-build call counting and full per-preset metric+Pareto coverage; confirmed live via CLI smoke test
TestCohesionShapes covers disjoint sets, pure chain, and clique fixtures
TestPreviewIsolation + live smoke test confirm advisory.json under preview/ and groups.json untouched
TestDeterminism (two-run byte-identical) and TestOneGraphBuild.test_zero_llm_calls (raising runner stub)
